verdict.rationale: Gitleaks can scan whole directories, entire git histories, and CI can auto-scan all PRs/commits for a team, which counts as bulk operation across many files/commits at once. However there's no evidence of a single command/API to batch-process multiple repositories or programmatically orchestrate large-scale multi-target scans beyond directory/repo scope. Missing for 10: multi-repo batch scanning support, a documented bulk/parallel API, and independent evidence of large-scale automation beyond single dir/git invocation.
